# dkcomp (vendored)

Source: <https://github.com/Kingizor/dkcomp>
Author: Kingizor
Licence: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

This is a subset of the upstream library: the compression/decompression sources
needed by DK Editor plus the public header and internal header. The command-line
tools, HTTP server and WebAssembly wrappers are not included.

Used formats:

- Big Data (DKC2/DKC3 tilesets, tilemaps, map chips)
- Small Data (DKC3 tilemaps)
- DKC CHR (DKC1 tilesets)
